Keep lid contours coherent and attached to the existing eye outline; the half-lidded bottom row should visibly lower the upper lid while preserving a plausible, partially visible iris and pupil in each eye. Preserve eye spacing, surrounding skin, hair, nose, background, composition, and color balance. Make only subtle eye-region changes. Do not change the brow shape, lighten the expression, enlarge the eyes, invent new eye colors, add smooth outlines, blur, anti-alias, or repaint non-eye features.
